why_not_vendored: See external/README.md. Four of these repositories may not legally be redistributed inside this one: turandai/gaussian_surfels and KeKsBoTer/cinematic-gaussians publish no LICENSE file at all (default copyright, all rights reserved), and graphdeco-inria/gaussian-splatting plus hbb1/2d-gaussian-splatting are under the Inria/MPII research-only licence. Vendoring them would also add ~1.2 GB and break the plain-text property of the transfer patch. Every target is therefore pinned by commit SHA and fetched on demand by scripts/fetch_external.py.

targets.name: nnU-Net (Isensee et al., Nature Methods 2021)
targets.role: Strong deep segmentation baseline. Produces a mask sequence; CV-Dyn2DGS converts it to a level set via levelset.sdf.signed_distance_from_mask and runs unchanged.
targets.caveat: A mask-derived SDF has a voxel-quantised zero level set. sdf_fidelity() measures the resulting eikonal violation, which is the mechanism by which this source can degrade the normal projection.

targets.name: CSTM: Continuous Spatio-Temporal Memory Networks (Ye et al., WACV 2025)
targets.role: 4D whole-sequence cine segmentation; the temporal-prior alternative to warm-started Chan-Vese.
targets.caveat: No public implementation was located. Listed so the gap is explicit; not fetchable.

targets.name: biv-me (Dillon, Mauger et al., Medical Image Analysis 2026)
targets.role: The strongest cardiac surface-only alternative: validated, multi-cohort, time-varying biventricular meshes. The honest competitor to a surface-native renderer.
targets.caveat: Biventricular, not LV-cavity-only. Compare clinical indices and storage, not silhouette IoU, unless the label scope is matched first.

targets.name: Gaussian Surfels (Dai et al., SIGGRAPH 2024)
targets.role: The other surfel formulation: a 3D Gaussian with z-scale set to 0 and the local z axis taken as the normal. This is what the thin-3dgs baseline approximates, so it is the external reference for RQ6.
targets.caveat: NO LICENCE FILE. Default copyright applies: you may clone and run it, but you may not redistribute it. Never copy it into this repository.

targets.name: 2D Gaussian Splatting (Huang et al., SIGGRAPH 2024)
targets.role: The upstream primitive this thesis builds on. Useful to confirm that the reimplemented rasteriser agrees with the reference on a non-medical scene before trusting it on cardiac data.
targets.caveat: Inria/MPII licence: research and evaluation use, non-commercial, redistribution restricted. Clone, do not vendor.

targets.name: 3D Gaussian Splatting (Kerbl et al., SIGGRAPH 2023)
targets.role: Free-geometry reference. Note that an in-pipeline equivalent exists (cvdyn2dgs.surfel.free3dgs) so the surface-pinning question can be answered without this clone.
targets.caveat: Inria/MPII licence. Clone, do not vendor.

targets.name: Dynamic Gaussians Mesh (Liu, Su, Wang 2024)
targets.role: Mesh from dynamic Gaussians with temporal vertex correspondence - the mesh-side analogue of the RQ5 baseline.

targets.name: AT-GS: Adaptive and Temporally Consistent Gaussian Surfels (Chen et al., WACV 2025)
targets.role: NEAREST NEIGHBOUR IN METHOD SPACE. Canonical Gaussian surfels, per-frame initialisation from the previous frame, adaptive densification, and a curvature-map temporal consistency term. Differs from CV-Dyn2DGS in one decisive respect: it learns the geometry instead of pinning it to a variational surface.
targets.caveat: Its curvature-consistency term targets the same phenomenon as this thesis's E_flicker, and it reports per-frame training time, so both the flicker metric and the precompute cost gain an external reference point. Highest-value comparison in layer 3.

targets.name: Dyna3DGR (Fu et al., MICCAI 2025)
targets.role: Closest cardiac prior work: explicit 3D Gaussians plus an implicit neural motion field, per-patient self-supervised on cine CMR.
targets.caveat: The proposal assumed no public implementation existed and invoked its own exemption from numerical comparison on that basis. The code IS public (this entry). The only remaining obstacle is hardware, so that exemption is provisional - see sections/02_related_work.tex.

targets.name: D-2DGS: Dynamic 2D Gaussians (Zhang et al., ACM MM 2025)
targets.role: Sparse control points deform 2D Gaussians; the learned-deformation alternative to normal projection onto a level set.

targets.name: 4D Gaussian Splatting (Wu et al., CVPR 2024)
targets.role: The standard dynamic-GS reference point for quality versus cost.

targets.name: SC-GS / Deformable 3D Gaussians (Yang et al. 2023)
targets.role: Sparse-control deformation field; the learned-deformation family.
targets.caveat: Licence not determined; treat as non-redistributable.

targets.name: Spacetime Gaussian Feature Splatting (Li et al., CVPR 2024)
targets.role: Compact spacetime primitives with real-time playback: the bytes-and-FPS reference for RQ4.
targets.caveat: GitHub reports NOASSERTION but the licence text is a permissive MIT-style grant by OPPO. Verify before relying on it.

targets.name: Cinematic Anatomy 3DGS (Niedermayr et al., VMV 2024)
targets.role: The closest published storage-and-FPS claim in medical visualisation: multi-GB volumes compressed to under 70 MB at 60 FPS. Static volume, not a time series - which is the axis this thesis adds.
targets.caveat: NO LICENCE FILE. Clone and run only; never vendor. Compare storage and frame rate; do not compare image content, since it renders a volume and CV-Dyn2DGS renders a surface.

targets.name: Pre-rendered video (H.265 / AV1)
targets.role: The competitor that must not be dodged. For a fixed, small set of viewpoints a pre-rendered video beats every 3D representation. Implemented in-pipeline: cvdyn2dgs.metrics.viewpoint computes the break-even viewpoint count, which is what turns 'we win for free viewpoints' from an assertion into a measurement.
targets.caveat: Bitrate is empirical. The implementation REFUSES a default bitrate: it requires either a measured encode or an explicitly stated assumption, because a guessed bitrate would be an invented result.
